changelog: v1.5.2: Allow official Indian government apps (including Kerala Police com.keralapolice, in.gov.*, and com.nic.*) only when verified from Play Store.

windows.changelog: v2.8.1: Fixes browsers being cut off with no rule behind it. The fan-out heuristic treated a signed browser whose signature was still being verified as an unsigned threat after eight peer addresses, and the threat response then tore down every established connection of that process - so Microsoft Edge failed to load pages while the firewall rule list was empty and the outbound policy said Allow. Fan-out is now only evidence for a binary that is known to be unsigned, severing is reserved for BLOCK_APP detections, and an advisory detection no longer skips the allow/block/prompt decision.
